summary:
Global incident: web-shop purchases (the Sage Active checkout) do not fire the Floodlight lead tag in DE (98), FR (129) or ES (36). The tag rules need ga4_customer_lead_type, which Tealium only derives from lead form names, and the checkout does not send one. In DE this broke with the Tealium publish of 24 Aug 2026; in FR and ES it was never set up (July 2026 versions behave the same). MarTech has confirmed the EU set-up is still pending. DE also loses web-shop trials (only DE offers trials). Order confirmations still fire the sales tags (DE 284, FR 464, ES 283).
FR is red because the two Sage 50 (formerly Ciel) pages on www.ciel.com have no cookie banner: analytics and advertising cookies are set and GA4, Google Ads and LinkedIn fire before any consent. This is a privacy problem rather than a measurement problem.
DE stays red for one reason: Floodlight tag 98 does not fire for web-shop trial and purchase submits (load rule 274, since the Tealium publish of 24 Aug 2026).
New today: the FR list from the paid search report is in (34 URLs: 32 on sage.com/fr-fr, 2 on ciel.com). All 32 sage.com pages answer. All 49 FR lead forms (demo, callback, quote, download, product tour) are active and their submit fires Floodlight 129 plus the matching lead-type tag, LinkedIn, Meta, TikTok and Reddit.
AT is red: its main Floodlight conversion (sage_012) is set to fire on a click on a button whose ID contains 'Submit', but the buttons on the AT contact and Infopaket forms have no ID, so it cannot fire when a form is sent. ES and PT: tag rule checks only.
Conversion checks now cover every market: for each one the monitor knows which Floodlight tag must fire for a lead form submit (DE 98, FR 129, ES 36, PT 402) and for a purchase (DE 284, FR 464, ES 283, ciel.com 9). In AT (Google Tag Manager) it reads each Floodlight trigger and checks the matching button or link exists.
Baselines: the current tag set was adopted as the baseline for all markets. New pages learn for 3 run days. A tag that fires on most pages of a market is expected on all of them. In DE this flags Microsoft UET (and the msclkid) as missing on the payroll and HR landing pages whenever those pages are checked.

FR.summary: 34 paid search URLs. The 2 ciel.com pages are checked automatically every day; the 32 sage.com pages wait for the bot-protection exception. All 49 lead forms on the sage.com pages pass.

brief.title: Why it is red
items: www.ciel.com shows no cookie banner.
GA4, Google Ads and LinkedIn fire and set cookies before any consent.

items.text: Affects both Sage 50 pages on ciel.com.
items.action: Raise with the privacy / web team.

brief.title: Web shop
items: Sage Active purchases do not fire Floodlight 129.
Never set up in FR; MarTech confirmed it is pending EU-wide.
Order confirmations still fire sales tag 464.

brief.title: Working
items: All 32 sage.com/fr-fr landing pages answer, none redirects.
49 lead forms on 31 pages: all active.
Every form submit fires Floodlight 129 and its lead-type tag (595, 608-610).
Submits also reach LinkedIn, Meta, TikTok and Reddit (no Microsoft UET in FR).

brief.title: Coverage
items: ciel.com pages: full daily check.
sage.com pages: forms and tag rules daily; page visits after the exception.

findings.CONS-01|fr-ciel-compta: www.ciel.com loads no consent tool at all (no OneTrust, no other CMP). Visitors are never asked. Owner: web team responsible for ciel.com, with the privacy team.
findings.CONS-02|fr-ciel-compta: Before any consent, the LinkedIn Insight tag fires and Google Ads cookies (_gcl_au, _gcl_aw) are set. Fix: add the OneTrust banner used on sage.com and gate the tags on consent in the ciel Tealium profile.
findings.CONS-03|fr-ciel-compta: Google tags (GA4 G-8EYWV34H9Z and G-PE4Z9JJWVN, Google Ads) send hits without any Consent Mode signal, so Google treats them as consented.
findings.CONS-01|fr-ciel-gestion-commerciale: Same as the Sage 50 Compta page: no consent tool on www.ciel.com.
findings.CONS-02|fr-ciel-gestion-commerciale: Same as the Sage 50 Compta page: LinkedIn and Google Ads cookies before consent.
findings.CONS-03|fr-ciel-gestion-commerciale: Same as the Sage 50 Compta page: Google hits without Consent Mode.
findings.CONV-01:ecom_buy|market: Floodlight 129 needs (action=form_submit_success OR sitecore form) AND ga4_customer_lead_type, which only gated forms set. The Sage Active checkout (/fr-fr/cart/buy/) sends customer_lead_type=ecom_buy without it. Same set-up already in July 2026, so it was never configured. Owner: MarTech (Tealium), as part of the pending EU web-shop set-up.

DE.summary: 5 of 116 landing pages checked in the Claude browser. Floodlight DC-5195550, Google Ads AW-970123043, GA4, LinkedIn and Meta fire on every page. The red status comes from the conversion load rule for ecom (tag 98), not from the landing pages.

findings.CONV-01:ecom_try|market: Tag 98's load rule requires rule 274 (ga4_customer_lead_type set). Tealium derives that value only from gate_content_name codes (_TRL_, _CON_ ...), and the Next.js checkout sends customer_lead_type=ecom_try without a gate_content_name. Before the publish of 2026-08-24 the tag fired (verified against the archived utag.js of 2026-07-13). Owner: MarTech (Tealium). Fix: drop rule 274 from tag 98, or map customer_lead_type to ga4_customer_lead_type for ecom events.
findings.CONV-01:ecom_buy|market: Same cause as ecom_try: rule 274 on tag 98 blocks ecom purchase submits.
findings.PAGE-03|de-cp-webinar-sage-x3: The page /de-de/cp/webinar-sage-x3/ no longer exists and redirects to https://www.sage.com/de-de/. Paid clicks land on the homepage instead of a webinar registration. Owner: paid media / agency: pause the ads or point them to a current X3 page.
findings.PAGE-03|de-cp-hr-zeiterfassung: Redirects to /cp/hr/zeiterfassungv2/. Tracking still works, but the click ID survives one more hop. Update the final URL in the campaigns to the v2 page.
findings.CONS-05|de-cp-hr-zeiterfassung: The embedded Brightcove video player sends player and impression metrics to metrics.brightcove.com before consent. This is not an ad tag, but it is third-party tracking before consent. Ask the privacy / web team whether the player should wait for consent or run in privacy mode.
findings.FORM-02|form:HCM_2701_NCA_DE_HRReadyNCAB: The form's gate_content_name starts with a space (' CL_HCM_DE_MED_CON_BOFU_HRReadyNCABeratung'). Tealium's lead-type mapping still reads it as contact, but load rule 331 requires the name to start with a letter, so Floodlight tag 389 never fires for this form. Owner: web/marketing automation team - remove the leading space in the Gated Content gate 'lastContentName'.
findings.FORM-02|form:BMS_18Q4_NCM_DE_DGWW_ER0460: gate_content_name 'CL_VAS_DE_DEM_S100Hosting_COM|TOP|GNRC' does not follow the CL_<product>_<country>_<segment>_<code>_ pattern. It still maps to trial_demo, so the main conversion tags fire. Low priority clean-up.

items: Floodlight sage_012 fires on a click on an element with 'Submit' in its ID.
The 'Absenden' and 'Jetzt kostenlos downloaden' buttons have no ID.

items.text: So form submits are not counted as conversions.
items.action: Fix the GTM trigger or give the buttons an ID.

brief.title: To check

brief.title: Working
items: Usercentrics banner, nothing before consent.
GTM, Floodlight page views and GA4 on all 6 pages; gclid reaches the form pages.

findings.GTM-07|conversion:sage_012: In GTM-PS6MXC (v13) Floodlight sageg0/sage_012 fires on gtm.click where Click ID contains 'Submit' (after Floodlight consent). The submit buttons on /kontaktformular/ and /kostenloses-infopaket/ are <input type=submit> without an id, so the trigger never matches. Owner: whoever manages GTM-PS6MXC / the sagedpw.at site. Fix: trigger on the form's success event (or a thank-you page view) instead of a click, or add an id containing 'Submit' to the buttons.
findings.GTM-07|conversion:sage_013: Floodlight sage_013 fires on a click on a link to uploads/SageDPWtoGO_Bestellformular_neu_3503_DE.pdf. None of the 6 paid landing pages or the 2 form pages link to it. Check whether the PDF is still offered somewhere; if not, the tag is obsolete.
